comparisons.peer_summary: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act regulates the development and deployment of AI systems within the EU, with phased-in requirements beginning in February 2025.
comparisons.comparison: Both Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan Chase disclose the implementation timeline and scope of the EU Artificial Intelligence Act. Goldman Sachs states that certain provisions of the EU AI Act apply from February 2025, with other provisions applying between August 2025 and August 2027, and that the Act establishes rules for placing AI systems on the market in the EU. JPMorgan Chase similarly notes that the EU AI Act regulates the development and deployment of AI systems within the EU, with phased-in requirements that began in February 2025. Both companies identify the same initial implementation date for specific provisions.

sentences.text: Certain provisions of the E.U. AI Act apply from February 2025, with other provisions applying between August 2025 and August 2027.
The E.U. AI Act establishes rules for placing on the market, putting into service, and using artificial intelligence systems in the E.U.
In addition, the EU Artificial Intelligence Act regulates the development and deployment of artificial intelligence systems within the EU, with phased-in requirements that began in February 2025.
